admins.heading: Admins
admins.lead: Everyone who can use this page. Only you see this section.

revokeConfirm.heading: Revoke admin?
revokeConfirm.lead: {{name}} (@{{username}}) will lose access to this page.

deleteConfirm.heading: Delete this task?
deleteConfirm.lead: “{{title}}” will be hidden from everyone but admins.
deleteConfirm.scope: Only a task with no history can go. One with a praxis, a duel, a metatask or a comment is refused — retire that one instead.
deleteConfirm.undo: Undo it any time: tick “Show deleted” and restore it to pending, active or retired.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search title, body, task or player…

hide.heading: Hide this praxis?
hide.lead: “{{title}}” will leave every list, its page will stop opening, and its points will stop counting. You can restore it from this tab (under All eras if it's from an earlier era).

fail.heading: Fail this praxis?
fail.lead: “{{title}}” stays on the site marked as failed, and its points will stop counting. You can restore it from this tab (under All eras if it's from an earlier era).

import.heading: Import tasks from CSV
import.columns: Columns: Name, Faction, Description, Level, Points. Leave Faction blank for a cross-faction task.
import.atomicNote: All rows import together. If any row is invalid nothing is created, and every problem is listed below so you can fix the file in one pass.
import.rejected: Nothing was imported. {{total}} row(s) need fixing:

empty.title: Queue clear
empty.body: Nothing flagged right now. Check back later.

actionLog.heading: Your last actions
actionLog.note: This session only — the list clears when you leave the page.

copyEdit.armedHint: Click any wording on the page to edit it. Links and buttons won't fire until you stop.
copyEdit.notCopy: That isn't editable wording — a name, a number or a player's own words.
copyEdit.pickKey: Several keys render that wording. Pick the one you meant.
copyEdit.pickForm: That wording has a form for each count. Pick the one you meant.
copyEdit.notSimpleKey: "{{key}}" has variant forms the editor can't reach. Edit that one in the catalog file.
copyEdit.revertError: Could not put the default wording back.
copyEdit.missingPlaceholder: Put {{placeholders}} back — the wording needs it to fill in a value.
copyEdit.scopeFaction: Belongs to one faction — only that faction's screens change.
copyEdit.scopeShared: Shared wording — changing it changes every faction.

copySheet.title: {{name}} copy sheet
copySheet.intro: Every place this faction speaks in its own words, beyond its name and description, on one page with sample data. Turn on admin mode, press “edit copy” and click any wording to change it. Clicks do nothing else here until you arm the editor.
copySheet.pickerHint: Pick a faction to edit the wording only it uses.

levelUpSheet.title: Level-up copy sheet
levelUpSheet.intro: The popup a player sees on reaching each level, all of them on one page: the rank and everything it unlocks. Turn on admin mode, press “edit copy” and click any wording to change it.

era.heading: Roll the game into a new era
era.blurb: An era is the ruleset the game runs on. Rolling ends the live one and opens the next, and everything below happens the moment you confirm it.
era.rollError: Could not roll the era over.
era.noTarget: Every era in the register is already live. There is nothing to roll into.

confirm.heading: Read this before you confirm

effects.characters: reset every character's score, level, vote budget and faction, by the incoming era's rules
effects.duels: freeze every unresolved duel into a permanent result

confirm.noUndo: There is no undo. Nothing brings back the era you are leaving.
confirm.working: rolling over, don't leave this page…
